title: outlaw list
description: The outlaws: open pull requests, branches and cards in progress with no epic or no feature, and the problems the Epics page flags, as the Outlaws page and `status outlaws -o json` show them. Work outside every epic is invisible to the epics, so this is where it shows (G-CARD-14).

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/control-room/app/v1: the form of control-room's answers (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml).

kind.description: Always OutlawList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

source.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always control-room, its product ID, since only control-room gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Every outlaw and problem, what could not be read, and the products a filter may name.
